page.title: Nori
page.meta_description: Nori is the dried seaweed sheet of rolls and gunkan, toasted so it crackles against rice. Related pages: Maki, Gunkan-maki, California roll.
page.content:
Toasted laver sheets that wrap maki and gunkan.

How Nori connects

  • Item: Maki — Nori is the wrapper of makizushi.
  • Item: Gunkan-maki — A nori strip is the 'hull' of gunkan-maki.
  • Item: California roll — The California roll hides nori inside the rice.

What is Nori?

Nori is the dried seaweed sheet of rolls and gunkan, toasted so it crackles against rice.

Key threads lead to Maki, Gunkan-maki and California roll.
